description: Powerful Performance: Equipped with Google’s latest Tensor G4 processor and 12GB RAM, ensuring seamless multitasking and blazing-fast speeds. Immersive Display: Features a 6.3-inch OLED screen with 120Hz refresh rate, HDR support, and peak brightness of 2700 nits for crystal-clear visuals. Pro-Grade Camera System: 50MP main sensor + 48MP ultrawide lens with AI-enhanced photography for stunning images. 10.5MP front camera for high-quality selfies and video calls. Long-Lasting Battery: 4700mAh battery with 45W fast charging and 15W wireless charging, keeping you powered up throughout the day. Premium & Durable Design: Sleek and stylish build with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection. Available in Peony, Wintergreen, Porcelain, and Obsidian colors.
